description: This Java class implements a servlet filter named CacheFilter, which is used to process HTTP requests and responses within a web application, primarily to prevent a specific security issue in OFBiz.

classes.name: CacheFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter class that processes HTTP requests to modify or inspect request data, mainly to prevent security issues.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Processes each HTTP request, extracts the URI without the context path, and passes the request and response along the filter chain.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration parameters.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the filter is taken out of service.
